propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as offline Jira oracle and passes field values into ObservedJira.PRESENT classification, so narrowing prev to a key-set would silently degrade drift classification
bridge_fsck is an out-of-band consumer of prev_snapshot.json that reads the working tree directly, not ctx.prev_snapshot, so standard reconcile_once tests do not exercise it
when prev_snapshot contains empty-dict entries (key-set fixture), field-dependent classifications must report indeterminate rather than inferring from absent fields
membership-only drift buckets (active-bound, missing-local, unbound-present) should remain unchanged between full-payload and key-set fixtures
bridge_fsck exit code and JSON schema shape must remain stable across both full-payload and key-set snapshot inputs
